_hinweis: Texts for the press conference (package 3l), kept separate from the logic. {gegner}, {spieler}, {platz}, {ziel} are replaced.

standard: Tomorrow it's {gegner}. What do you expect?
Position {platz} before facing {gegner}: how's the mood?
{gegner} are known as awkward opponents. Your tactics?
sieg: A win against {gegner}. What was the key?
Your team looked very solid today. Happy?
niederlage: The defeat to {gegner} hurts. Where did it go wrong?
The fans booed at the end. Can you understand that?
remis: A draw against {gegner}. A point gained or two dropped?
Is a point like that enough for your goals?
serie_gut: The run goes on. How far can it go?

geruecht: Word is {spieler} could leave the club. Is there any truth in it?
ausfall: {spieler} is out. How will you cope without him?

antworten.ehrlich: Honestly: I'll tell it like it is.
antworten.kaempferisch: We're not giving up, we're going for it!
antworten.ausweichend: I won't comment on that today.
antworten.kritik: Some players weren't at their level today.
antworten.diplomatisch: We respect everyone and keep working calmly.

zusage_antwort.zusage_ziel: Yes. We'll do it, you have my word.

ehrlich: {gegner} are in good shape, it won't be easy. But we know what we can do.
Honestly, I expect a tight game against {gegner}. Position {platz} is just a snapshot.
kaempferisch: We are not going to {gegner} to watch. We want the three points.
However strong {gegner} are, we go into the game with confidence.
diplomatisch: {gegner} have my respect. We prepare calmly and focus on ourselves.
Every game has its own story. Against {gegner} only the performance on the day counts.
ausweichend: I won't say anything about our tactics against {gegner} before the game.
Ask me again tomorrow after the final whistle.

ehrlich: The win against {gegner} was deserved, but not everything worked.
We won because we were sharper in the decisive moments.
lob: The lads did everything we talked about against {gegner}. I'm proud.
That was a mature performance from the whole team.
kritik: We won, but I didn't like the second half. We will talk about it.
Three points against {gegner}, fine. Still, we were careless too often.

ehrlich: {gegner} were better today, you have to accept that.
We made too many simple mistakes and paid for them.
kaempferisch: This defeat against {gegner} won't knock us down. We will hit back.
Wipe our mouths and carry on. Next week we show a different face.
kontern: You should take a close look at the decision before their opener.
Anyone talking about a crisis hasn't watched the last few weeks.
diplomatisch: Congratulations to {gegner}. We will analyse it calmly.
Days like this happen. We learn from them.

ehrlich: I can live with the point against {gegner}, there wasn't more in it today.
A fair draw, both sides had their chances.
kaempferisch: One point is too little for us. We wanted to beat {gegner}.
We should have won it. Next time we take three.
kritik: We gave away two points. That annoys me.
We lacked ruthlessness up front, and I will tell the team that too.

ehrlich: The run is nice, but it won't play for us at the weekend.
We enjoy it, but we stay grounded.
lob: The team has been working superbly for weeks. They have earned this run.
I have rarely seen a group that runs for each other like this.
kritik: Right now we must not let up. I already see the first signs.
The run hides a few weaknesses. We are working on them.

ehrlich: The results are not good enough, everyone here knows that.
We are in a difficult spell. I take responsibility.
kaempferisch: I won't run away from this. We will get out of it together.
The table is decided at the end. We will turn this around.
kontern: My job is not the issue. Ask about the game instead.
You have been writing these questions for weeks. We keep working.
diplomatisch: I speak to the board regularly, we agree on the way forward.
We stay calm. Panic has never helped any team.

ehrlich: {spieler} played a very good game today, no more and no less.
{spieler} was strong, but he knows himself he can still improve.
lob: {spieler} was outstanding today. Players like him win games.
What {spieler} showed today was top class.
kritik: {spieler} was good, but we win as a team, not because of one player.
I don't want to hype {spieler}. Consistency is what counts.

ehrlich: The relationship is professional. There are different opinions, that is normal.
Of course the board expects more. So do I.
lob: I feel the backing of the board every day.
The board works superbly with us.
diplomatisch: What is discussed internally stays internal.
We all pull in the same direction, even if there is a need to talk.

ehrlich: There is interest in {spieler}, that is normal for good players. Nothing is decided.
{spieler} is under contract with us. Everything else we discuss internally.
kontern: Who writes these rumours about {spieler}? None of it is true.
I don't comment on stories someone made up.
ausweichend: I won't say anything about {spieler} today.
Transfers are not a topic for a press conference.

ehrlich: Losing {spieler} hurts, there is no sugar-coating it.
We will miss {spieler}. Others must take responsibility now.
kaempferisch: We have a deep squad. Whoever comes in will give everything.
There are no excuses. We will cope together.
lob: I trust the lads who now play instead of {spieler}.
Our squad is strong enough, I have seen it in training.

ehrlich: {spieler} needs a few more weeks to know all the routines.
We give {spieler} time, he should settle in.
lob: {spieler} has already shown in training why we signed him.
With {spieler} we got exactly the player we wanted.
ausweichend: I'd rather talk about individual players after a few games.
Let's wait and see what the pitch says.

ehrlich: Position {ziel} is realistic, but in football you can't promise anything.
We work for position {ziel}, there is no guarantee.
diplomatisch: The target is set, and everyone at the club supports it.
We go game by game, everyone knows the target.
kontern: I make promises at the end of the season, not in autumn.
You want a headline, I want points.
ausweichend: I have said everything about that.

ehrlich: I want to keep {spieler}, but anything is possible in football.
{spieler} is important to us. Whether he stays doesn't depend on me alone.
diplomatisch: We are talking calmly with {spieler} and his people.
{spieler} feels at home here, that's what counts for me.
kontern: The only guarantees come with fridges.
Ask {spieler} himself, he will tell you the same.
ausweichend: I won't comment on contract matters in public.
